title: gaultheria sumatrensis
intro: Gaultheria sumatrensis, commonly known as the Sumatran Gaultheria or Indian Wintergreen, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce pain and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Gaultheria sumatrensis are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils like methyl salicylate. The essential oil extracted from this plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.
